text.p: These are the leading stories in the Skopje press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- At least 11 people were killed and over 40 injured in Berovo, 150 kilometres west of Skopje, when lightning struck a group of 15 thousand people at a religious gathering.
- Opposition says the government's arrogance is provoking a boycott of the elections scheduled for this fall and will do everything to convince the government to accept a compromise.
- Foreign credits in Macedonia are largely approved for productive investments but there are still three times more requests than the available ten million German marks.
